turns.mechanic: هيونداي سوناتا هايبرد 2020 محرك 2.0، عليها كود P199000 من كمبيوتر الجير
السيارة كانت عاملة حادث من قدام وغيرنا ضفيرة الهاي فولتج وفحصنا الفيوزات سليمة، ولسا العطل موجود
غيرنا وحدة الـ OPU ومسحنا الأعطال، وباللايف داتا صار يوصلها هاي فولتج والسيارة اشتغلت طبيعي

must_do: Offer the solved case as a hint, with its source, and say it is one earlier repair, not a confirmed fix for this car
Say which car the case was done on, or that the report did not record it
Ask for, or point to, the check that shows the case applies before any part is replaced
Reply in the mechanic's language with codes and part names in English letters
Say that in the case the OPU was replaced only after the wiring was repaired and the fuses checked, and that the scan tool showed the OPU was not receiving sufficient voltage
must_not: Tell the mechanic to replace a part without a check
Present the case as a manufacturer procedure
State a pin, value or specification that is not in the case
Say the OPU is the cause of every P199000
case_in_kb.final_cause: Oil Pump Control Unit (OPU) replaced, after the high-voltage wiring and the OPU fuses had been checked

must_do: Say there is no verified information for this vehicle and fault in the knowledge base

Ask follow-up questions that narrow the fault

must_not: Present the fix from the held-out case as a known or verified fix
State a pin, value or specification
